fields.name: Name
fields.description: Deprecated; ignored. The worktree name/branch is always <callerID>-<random> (per-agent exclusive, never collides).

fields.name: BaseRef
fields.description: commit-ish the new branch starts from; empty = HEAD.

fields.name: Mode
fields.description: discard | merge. discard deletes the worktree; merge lands its branch on the main repo's base branch.

fields.name: Force
fields.description: discard only: required when the worktree has uncommitted changes.

fields.name: BaseBranch
fields.description: merge only: target branch in the main repo; empty = repo default (main/master).

fields.name: ForceRefresh
fields.description: Re-generate even if a ready snapshot exists.

fields.name: TestCommand
fields.description: Optional shell command for test execution during freeze. Empty = skip tests. Human callers only.

fields.name: FilePath
fields.description: File path within the child's worktree.

fields.name: Offset
fields.description: Line offset (1-based) for pagination. Omit for start of file.

callables.name: list
callables.description: List directory contents as plain text (one entry per line, directories end with /). Depth controls how many levels to descend: 0 or omit for current directory only, 1 for one level, 2 for two levels, -1 for full recursion. Skips node_modules, .git, vendor, dist, build. Hidden entries (names starting with '.') are omitted by default.

callables.name: list_json
callables.description: List directory contents as JSON entries. Depth controls how many levels to descend: 0 or omit for current directory only, 1 for one level, 2 for two levels, -1 for full recursion. Skips node_modules, .git, vendor, dist, build. Hidden entries (names starting with '.') are omitted by default.

callables.name: edit
callables.description: Edit an existing file by replacing exact old_string text with new_string. By default, old_string must be non-empty, differ from new_string, and occur exactly once; use replace_all=true only when every occurrence should change. If old_string is not found, re-read the file and use the exact current text. Use overwrite=true to replace the entire existing file, or project.write to create a missing file. Errors are prefixed with project.edit; successful edits return replacement counts and hunks.

callables.name: glob
callables.description: Find files by glob pattern (e.g. **/*.go). Skips node_modules, .git, vendor, dist, build and .gitignored entries by default. Set no_ignore=true to bypass all ignore layers.

callables.name: grep
callables.description: Search file contents with a Go-compatible regular expression. Returns matching file paths by default; use output_mode=content for lines or output_mode=count for per-file counts. An empty result is a successful search with no matches. Errors are prefixed with project.grep; invalid pattern means the regex could not be compiled. Skips node_modules, .git, vendor, dist, build and .gitignored entries by default; set no_ignore=true to bypass all ignore layers.

callables.name: list
callables.description: List directory contents as plain text (one entry per line, directories end with /). Depth controls how many levels to descend: 0 or omit for current directory only, 1 for one level, 2 for two levels, -1 for full recursion. Skips node_modules, .git, vendor, dist, build. Hidden entries (names starting with '.') are omitted by default.

callables.name: list_json
callables.description: List directory contents as JSON entries. Depth controls how many levels to descend: 0 or omit for current directory only, 1 for one level, 2 for two levels, -1 for full recursion. Skips node_modules, .git, vendor, dist, build. Hidden entries (names starting with '.') are omitted by default.

callables.name: review_changeset
callables.description: Generate or retrieve a frozen, read-only changeset summary for a workflow child agent's worktree. Includes baseline/HEAD, commit list, tracked file status with diff metadata, untracked file summaries, rename/deletion detection, binary/generated markers, and test results. Only the child's direct parent agent or a trusted human/admin may call this.

callables.name: review_changeset_clear
callables.description: Internal: drop the cached changeset for an agent. Called by workspace after approve/reject to free memory.

callables.name: review_changeset_finalize
callables.description: Internal: apply the async generation result on the project owner loop. Called by the goroutine via self-invoke.

callables.name: review_changeset_freeze
callables.description: Internal: kick off async changeset generation for a workflow child agent entering pending_review. Registers a preparing placeholder immediately and launches a background goroutine. Called by the agent's turn engine, not directly by LLMs.

callables.name: review_file_content
callables.description: Read paginated file content from a frozen review changeset. For tracked modified files, returns the unified diff; for untracked files, returns the full content. Large outputs are paginated via Offset/Limit.

callables.name: shell_exec
callables.description:
Execute a command in the project directory. External binaries run via the system shell.

Timeout is in milliseconds; default 30000 (30s). Values below 1000 are clamped to the default. Larger values are allowed, so long-running commands can request more time explicitly.

callables.name: wiki_close_card
callables.description: Close a card from the story river (remove if present).

callables.name: wiki_create_map
callables.description: Create a root map card (type=map) with correct frontmatter and a body template. Replaces hand-written YAML for workflow maps.

callables.name: wiki_create_task_card
callables.description: Create a task card under a map, atomically append its id to the map's include list, and optionally wire depends_on edges. Replaces the error-prone two-step manual process.

callables.name: wiki_edit_constraints
callables.description: Edit the project constraints mono card using old_string/new_string replacement, preserving YAML frontmatter. The card is created automatically if it does not exist.

callables.name: wiki_edit_summary
callables.description: Edit the project summary mono card using old_string/new_string replacement, preserving YAML frontmatter. The card is created automatically if it does not exist.

callables.name: wiki_ensure_builtins
callables.description: Ensure all builtin mono cards exist. Returns IDs of newly created cards. Useful for upgrades or on-demand seeding.

callables.name: wiki_frontier
callables.description: Return the deterministic frontier for a workflow map: task cards that are unclaimed (status backlog/todo) and whose all depends_on dependencies are done.

callables.name: wiki_get_card_hierarchy
callables.description: Explore the card hierarchy around a given card. Returns a tree string with parents (↑) and children (↓) up to the requested level.

callables.name: wiki_get_concept_tree
callables.description: Get a normalized concept tree projection on demand.

callables.name: wiki_get_constraints
callables.description: Get the project constraints mono card. The card is created automatically if it does not exist.

callables.name: wiki_get_summary
callables.description: Get the project summary mono card. The card is created automatically if it does not exist.

callables.name: wiki_list_all_cards
callables.description: List all project mono cards as a flat array.

callables.name: wiki_list_cards
callables.description: List project cards as a tree under a root (default toc). Use Depth/Limit to cap output size.

callables.name: wiki_list_dependencies
callables.description: List task-card data.depends_on edges (optionally filtered to one workflow map).

callables.name: wiki_list_timers
callables.description: List all scheduled timer cards and their next fire times.

callables.name: wiki_open_card
callables.description: Open a card in the story river (prepend, idempotent).

callables.name: wiki_search_card_content
callables.description: Search project mono cards by body content (substring or /regexp/) with the same metadata filters as search_cards (tags, status, type, source, list, parent, priority, due, modified/created/due time windows) plus optional OrderBy. Returns matching cards with a snippet and line number of the first match, and an untruncated Total. Use this to find which cards mention a concept; use search_cards for title/metadata queries.

callables.name: wiki_search_cards
callables.description: Search project mono cards by title (substring or /regexp/) with metadata filters: tags, status, type, source, list, parent, priority, due, modified/created/due time windows, and optional OrderBy (field or -field for descending: modified, created, due, title, priority). Returns metadata only with an untruncated Total.

callables.name: wiki_set_map_owner
callables.description: Bind an agent to a root map card by stamping ownerAgentId into its Data block. Enforces single-binding.

callables.name: wiki_set_status
callables.description: Atomically update a card's frontmatter status field without a full Raw rewrite. Lightweight path for programmatic status transitions.

callables.name: wiki_set_task_dependencies
callables.description: Replace a task card's data.depends_on list after validating its workflow scope.

callables.name: wiki_trigger_timer_card
callables.description: Trigger a scheduled wiki card immediately without changing its schedule.

callables.name: wiki_validate_card
callables.description: Validate a card's raw markdown without persisting it. Returns structured validation errors.

callables.name: worktree_agent_bindings

callables.name: worktree_create
callables.description: Create a linked git worktree for isolated agent operations. Requires a name; creates a branch and checks out into .git/wt/<id>.

callables.name: worktree_discard
callables.description: Discard (remove) a worktree. If the worktree has uncommitted changes, set force=true to override.

callables.name: worktree_enter
callables.description: Enter (self-bind) a per-agent exclusive worktree for this session. Idempotent: returns the current binding if already bound. Name is ignored; the worktree is named after the caller to enforce one-agent-one-worktree isolation.

callables.name: worktree_get

callables.name: worktree_list

callables.name: worktree_release_binding
callables.description: Internal: invoked by workspace.delete_agent when an agent is destroyed, so the project can drop the agent→worktree binding and remove the worktree if no other agent remains bound.

callables.name: write
callables.description: Create or overwrite a file within a configured root.

callables.name: bash
callables.description:
Execute a bash command in the project directory.

IMPORTANT: Avoid using this tool to run file operations that have dedicated tools. Instead, use the appropriate tool for better results:
- File search: use project.glob (NOT find or ls)
- Content search: use project.grep (NOT grep or rg)
- Read files: use project.read (NOT cat/head/tail)
- Edit files: use project.edit (NOT sed/awk)
- Write files: use project.write (NOT echo >)
- List directories: use project.list (NOT ls)

callables.name: exec
callables.description:
Execute a command. Built-in file commands (ls, cat, mkdir, rm, cp, mv, pwd, echo, write) run in a sandboxed VFS. Allowlisted external binaries (go, python, npm, git, make, etc.) run via the system shell. grep and find run as real system binaries. Dangerous commands (wget, nc, ssh, sudo, etc.) are blocked; curl is allowed.

For file operations, dedicated project tools are preferred:
- File search: use project.glob (NOT find)
- Content search: use project.grep (NOT grep)
- Read files: use project.read (NOT cat/head/tail)
- Edit files: use project.edit (NOT sed/awk)
- Write files: use project.write (NOT echo >)
- List directories: use project.list (NOT ls)
